# cse455-final-project

CSE 455/555 project: a custom Transformer trained for structured command generation from everyday English.

## Stage 1: Pretrain a GPT from scratch

[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/daniya-safdar/cse455-final-project/blob/main/stage1_pretrain.ipynb)

Note: since this is a private repo, the badge above will 404. Instead, in Colab use **File → Open notebook → GitHub tab**, and check **"Include private repos"** to load it.

`stage1_pretrain.ipynb` is a decoder-only Transformer written from scratch in PyTorch (~30M params),
pretrained on TinyStories. Produces the loss curve, validation perplexity, and text samples.

**Reproduce:** open the notebook in Colab (badge above) → `Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU`
→ `Runtime → Run all`. ~30 minutes on a free T4.

## Working on the project (Colab ↔ GitHub)

1. Open a notebook via its Colab badge (this loads it straight from this repo).
2. Make your changes / run cells in Colab.
3. Press `Cmd/Ctrl+S` → **Save a copy in GitHub** → keep the same file path and branch `main` → OK.
   Colab creates a git commit in this repo; outputs (plots, samples) are saved with the notebook.

The first time, Colab will ask you to authorize GitHub access.

## Repo layout

- `PROPOSAL.md`: project proposal + plan (Jul 10 deliverable)
- `stage1_pretrain.ipynb`: Stage 1, from-scratch GPT pretraining on TinyStories
- Stage 2 (SFT + DPO for intent/slot extraction on SNIPS + ATIS) is coming next, see the proposal
